correctness.rationale: Two-one squares use exactly one of two adjacent marker pairs, leading to necessary and sufficient integer interval feasibility by a capped sum. All-zero cases have r=1,...,floor(max gap/2). The uniform compositions converge to Dirichlet(1,1,1,1). Rational vertex enumeration gives denominator dividing 12 for two four-polytopes; Ehrhart fourth differences 15552 and 7488 yield volumes 1/32 and 13/864. With E max/2=25/96 this yields 157/288. Independent direct factor verification passed 40920 words, and exact lattice counts and volumes passed. No finite test is presented as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: Abelian-nonequivalence is a historically motivated separate invariant from literal square diversity. The first sparse composition where two pair-families compete yields a complete exact vector spectrum, a nondegenerate conditional limit, and a new explicit rational mean using genuinely four-dimensional intersection volume. This is neither a general textbook extremal bound nor an arbitrary numerical slice; relevance is to sparse repetition spectra and Parikh-vector enumeration.
